summary.result: The predicted air-voids based on the NDDG air-voids obtained from 50mm depth were found to be reliable levels with $R^2{\fallingdotseq}0.9$ .
summary.background: Most of all, confirming air void or density of pavement layer is important for quality control of field compaction level of asphalt concrete pavement.
summary.method: Four sections of field asphalt pavements were tested using the NDDG, and actual air voids were also measured from field cores taken from the site where the NDDG air-void was measured.
